title: W-qos lane-margin resolve boundary has no unit test — golden-only coverage
evidence:
relieved := bound > margin &&
				bundle_class_queue(state, cat, b, ac.class) + margin < bound &&
				!bundle_lane_at(state, cat, b, bound - margin)

(grep across the tree: "core/crisis.odin:127:bundle_lane_at :: proc(state: ^Run_State, cat: ^Catalogs, bi: u32, at: u32) -> bool" and "core/crisis.odin:404:\t\t\t\t!bundle_lane_at(state, cat, b, bound - margin)" are the ONLY non-probe references — no test file names it; the rework diff adds only tests (m) renumber and (n) pool. The re-blessed qos.t1 is the sole pin: " 1198 6d32f0a7d8ecfc49 / 1199 b270a455c5e6c248 / 1200 6124c5b772c0aa7b / -1201 97a59a96cbac08a8" — ticks 1201-1500 shifted, trigger tick 1200 unchanged.)
detail: The churn fix's new resolve condition (a lane at or above bound−margin blocks resolve, another class holding the lane included) is exercised only by the re-blessed golden; no core test covers its boundary — violating the project's lowest-layer pin rule.
recommended_fix: Add a core @(test): a lane held at bound−margin by a different class blocks resolve; a backlog dip below bound with the lane still ≥ bound−margin must not resolve.

title: Pool-exhaustion banner title variant has no pixel or lint coverage
evidence:
title = fmt.aprintf("!!  %s: %s ACTIVE - network at capacity (pool exhausted)",
				arch, sp_name, allocator = context.temp_allocator)

(data/balance.json: "pool_max_packets": 512, — no demo reaches it, so no blessed capture renders this variant; probe replay of the qos scenario prints "tick=1200 TRIGGERED cause=1 class=1 target=0 pipe=0" — Saturated_Bundle is the only rendered crisis. tools/lint.sh ends at "-- gate 5: no load-balancing mechanic in core" — no gate greps non-ASCII in draw_text_c-fed strings.)
detail: Only the Saturated_Bundle title is pixel-pinned by the re-blessed captures; the Pool_Exhaustion title's mojibake fix is verified by nothing — a future em-dash regression in that string would pass every gate.
recommended_fix: Add a lint gate rejecting non-ASCII runes in draw_text_c-fed strings, or a unit test asserting both title formats are pure ASCII.
